source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** Stratagem can pick this unit even after being used earlier in the phase. When it picks this unit:

- That use costs 1CP less.
- That use doesn't block the Stratagem from being used on other units in the phase.
- Whenever the unit **declares a charge** while one of your **engaged** **PSYKER** units is no more than 12" from it, it can re-roll the **Charge roll** for it, but its **Charge move** must then finish engaged with one of the enemy units engaged with that **PSYKER** unit.

It is unclear whether the charge part also covers charges made without that Stratagem.

openQuestions: The charge part is printed as an item of the list that follows the Heroic Intervention use, but it is worded as any charge this unit declares; the text does not settle whether it is limited to the charge that use allows.
